AI-Powered Diagnostic Innovations for Early Detection, Made Simple

Medzak Healthcare delivers medical-grade ocular and metabolomic diagnostics for hospitals, labs, and outreach camps. Patented, clinically validated technology built for early detection — without the high cost of traditional equipment.
Selected for the RICH-AID Program Start-up Cohort

Shortlisted in Digital Health Start-ups Cohort 2

Women in Technology Ignite, India MATLAB Expo 2020
Medzak, one of the Top 3 innovators, at the MedTech Challenge’2019 for the innovation.

Founded in 2018, Medzak Healthcare started with a mission to close the gap between the world’s growing burden of eye and metabolic disease and the diagnostic tools available to detect it early — before it becomes expensive, invasive, or irreversible.
To build portable, affordable, AI-powered diagnostic devices for ocular and metabolic health, that bring hospital-grade screening to OPDs, outreach camps, and underserved communities.
To see a world where no patient loses their sight, or their health, to a disease that could have been caught early.

Across two platforms, MeiboX for ocular diagnostics and Metabo-X for metabolic risk prediction, we combine imaging, AI, and clinical validation into devices that are fast, low-cost, and built for real-world care.

MeiboX Advanced 4-in-1 AI-Powered Ocular Diagnostic Device

Simplify eye screening with a portable, handheld device that combines IR, visible, ultrasonic, and fluorescence imaging in one system. AI-guided diagnosis detects 10 major surface eye diseases in under 2 minutes, with >92% imaging accuracy — no specialist equipment or long OPD queues required.
Engineered for sharp, low-power imaging at close range, the VuOpt optics lens system delivers up to 40% MTF and a 5–10 cm detection range.

An optical imaging lens system for providing high-efficiency light delivery to biological organisms, tissues, or agents, and more particularly relates to embedding collinear illumination optics within a high-light-collection, low-numerical-aperture lens with low power consumption. Our solution is compact, and close-range lenses are designed to provide high image quality with low distortion, especially for medical imaging.

Detect disease risk years before symptoms appear. Metabo-X analyzes disease-linked metabolites from a simple blood sample, using AI to generate a personalized risk score, nutrition guidance, and physician-reviewed therapy recommendations — built as a clinical decision aid, not a replacement for diagnosis.

Varsha is the Founder and Director of Medzak Healthcare. Varsha leads the innovation of product development and has more than 10 years of experience in research and development. She received the Gandhian Young Technological Innovation Awards (GYTI)-2016 and was the Top 10 finalist in Intel-DST Challenge-2016. She was also selected as one of the Indian delegates to represent India at the 2nd BRICS-Young Scientist Forum, 2017, in Hangzhou, China. Varsha has a Ph.D. in Biochemistry & Molecular Biology from Panjab University.
